prompt: A traditional Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print, with bold black keyblock outlines, flat organic mineral colors, and a faint wood grain in the paper. The background stays spare and elegant, with open space around the subject.

A gouache illustration painted in thick matte color, with visible brush marks and a lively handmade palette. The face is simplified into clear painted shapes, and the background is a soft, uncluttered field of color.
A whimsical children's storybook illustration in a cozy warm palette, with clean ink outlines and a stylized hand-drawn subject. Behind the figure is only a simple sky.
An abstract geometric portrait whose face is built from circles and triangles in high-contrast flat colors. The background is one plain field.
A cyberpunk vector illustration of sharp neon color blocks, hard-edged shading, and bold graphic lines. The background is a dark, clean, nearly empty field.

style_name: 調色刀油畫風 (Palette Knife Painting)
prompt: A heavy palette-knife oil painting, with thick impasto ridges, bold strokes of saturated color, and strong light against shadow. The background dissolves into a few broad slabs of paint.

An Art Deco illustration of elegant geometric ornament, bold symmetrical lines, and a high-contrast palette of gold against deep color. The background is a simple stylized pattern that stays behind the subject.
An ancient fresco on textured plaster, painted in muted but opaque pigments with simplified facial planes. The background is a plain, weathered wall.
An Art Nouveau illustration in the spirit of Alphonse Mucha, with flowing contour lines, ornate floral borders, and flat muted color. The background remains an uncluttered vintage field of pattern.
A low-poly artwork made of sharp triangular facets and high-contrast blocks of gradient color. The background is a plain, minimal field.
A Pop Art screen print in the spirit of Andy Warhol, with bold flat color, visible print grain, and one solid background color. The face is reduced to iconic graphic shapes.

A 1980s Japanese city-pop illustration, with sharp clean outlines and a glossy palette of retro pastel and neon. The whole frame is a sunset city of skyline, palm trees, and glowing abstract light shapes.
A cute chibi anime illustration with an oversized head, a tiny body, thick clean outlines, and bright flat color. The background is almost empty.

style_name: 局部色彩黑色電影風 (Noir with Spot Color)
prompt: A film-noir comic panel in high-contrast black and white, with one bright spot color such as red or yellow. The background is a plain, minimal field.

style_name: 復古橡皮管動畫風 (Rubber Hose Cartoon)
prompt: A 1930s rubber-hose cartoon, with bold ink lines, pie-cut eyes, simple flat color, and an expressive stylized figure. The background is a plain off-white sheet.

style_name: 復古時尚插畫風 (Retro Editorial Fashion Illustration)
prompt: A mid-century editorial fashion illustration painted in flat gold and simplified blocks of cream, coral, ochre, teal, and soft black. The frame is an abstract interior of geometric decor and warm color fields on subtly grained paper, like a museum poster with no lettering.

style_name: 極簡高級時尚線稿風 (Minimalist Fashion Linework)
prompt: A refined fashion drawing in clean expressive lines and thin washes of blush, taupe, cream, muted red, and soft charcoal. The background stays plain so the figure separates clearly from it.
A refined woodcut portrait cut with elegant engraved lines and strong black-and-white contrast. The background is a clean simplified field, and the marks stay open enough to read from a distance.

style_name: 經典素描人像 (Classic Sketch & Charcoal)
prompt: A classic charcoal and pencil sketch with delicate facial detail, expressive hatching, and rich grayscale on a clean white sheet. The drawn subject is the clear focus of the page.

style_name: 新中式水墨風 (New Chinese Ink Wash)
prompt: A modern Chinese ink-wash painting on soft xuan paper, with refined brush lines, muted color accents, and gentle ink diffusion. The background is mostly empty space, with a hint of mist and a distant mountain or bamboo silhouette.

style_name: 剪紙極簡人像風 (Paper-cut Minimal Portrait)
prompt: A layered paper-cut portrait in cream, terracotta, sage, navy, and warm beige, with a clean silhouette and very little facial detail. The background is a simple sheet so the paper layers stay distinct.
A cinematic chiaroscuro picture in black and white, with deep shadow against a hard pool of light that models the face, and a solid pitch-black background.

style_name: 半色調印刷風 (Halftone Print Portrait)
prompt: A refined halftone print shaded with controlled dots and strong black-and-white contrast on a clean, simple ground. The tonal steps stay broad so the face reads as a vintage print.

style_name: 1950年代復古旅行海報風 (1950s Travel Poster)
prompt: A 1950s travel poster of flat vector shapes, screen-print texture, and a small set of bold colors. The background is a simplified field of geometric scenery, with no lettering.

style_name: 街頭塗鴉插畫風 (Urban Street-Art Illustration)
prompt: A stylized urban street-art painting with bold outlines, gritty brush texture, and a warm muted palette on a wall of layered spray. The wall carries abstract spray marks, drips, and paint gestures that never form words or letters.
